sources.title: Announcing Cohere's Command A Reasoning Model
sources.evidence: Dated August 21, 2025 announcement names command-a-reasoning-08-2025, 111 billion parameters, 256K context, 23 languages, reasoning controls and tool use. Reopened October 27, 2026: the original exact-model launch still explicitly states 111 billion parameters and supplies no separate active count.

sources.title: Model Card for Cohere Labs Command A Reasoning
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint card identifies Cohere and Cohere Labs, open weights, 111B size, CC-BY-NC with acceptable-use requirements, text-only input and text output, reasoning, conversational tools, and an autoregressive Transformer combining sliding-window/RoPE and global attention. Reopened October 27: both the summary and Model Size still state 111 billion parameters; no separately defined active count is present.

sources.title: CC-BY-NC 4.0 License with Acceptable Use Addendum
sources.evidence: The model card links this CC-BY-NC 4.0 license with the Cohere Labs Acceptable Use Addendum.

sources.title: Cohere's Command A Reasoning Model
sources.evidence: Exact dated model ID; 256,000-token context; 32,000-token maximum output; enterprise agents, RAG, tools and multilingual use.

sources.title: Introducing Command A+: Making sovereign agentic capabilities available to all
sources.evidence: May 20, 2026 comparison explicitly includes Command A Reasoning in the Command A family: size 111B, reasoning and tools supported, multimodal absent, 23 languages. The 218B total / 25B active figures belong to Command A+, not this model. Fresh October 27 review of the full comparison checks the Size row (218B A25B versus 111B) and efficiency paragraph. The latter contrasts A+ total/active counts with Reasoning's 111B dense architecture, but does not label Reasoning's 111B as active or establish a dense-model counting convention. Speed/latency comparisons likewise do not provide an active-count column.

sources.title: Official checkpoint public repository metadata
sources.publisher: Hugging Face metadata for Cohere Labs checkpoint
sources.evidence: Metadata for revision bd39aafe2c5e71a044d2f1674accfd9b384d3dbb identifies Cohere2ForCausalLM, model_type cohere2, Command A 03-2025 base, cc-by-nc-4.0, and a safetensors aggregate of 111,057,580,032 BF16 elements. Repository creation was August 12, 2025; this alone does not establish public release. Fresh October 27 API fetch returns the same revision, named Command A base and 111,057,580,032 BF16 aggregate; this is supporting total metadata, not an active count.

sources.title: Transformers Cohere2ForCausalLM implementation, v4.55.0
sources.evidence: Implementation matching the checkpoint architecture contains causal decoder attention and dense gated MLP projections in each decoder layer. Rotary frequencies are non-persistent buffers. This supports dense Transformer classification, without equating active and total parameters.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint configuration (gated)
sources.evidence: Direct configuration access returned HTTP 401. Full checkpoint configuration and individual tensor headers were not inspected; no independently reconstructed exact learned-parameter count is claimed.

sources.title: Command A Reasoning documentation source
sources.evidence: Source lists the supported capability flags without Image Inputs; the rendered page extraction includes all capability labels. Confirms 256,000 context and the exact model ID. Its draft createdAt date is not a release announcement.

sources.title: Baseline Hugging Face URL
sources.evidence: Baseline URL returned HTTP 401; the accessible official checkpoint is CohereLabs/command-a-reasoning-08-2025.

sources.title: OCI Cohere Command A Reasoning
sources.evidence: Provider page claims image inputs and a four-layer architecture. These conflict with Cohere's explicit text-only card and its attention-pattern description; provider statements are not adopted for the Cohere checkpoint.

sources.title: Command A: An Enterprise-Ready Large Language Model
sources.evidence: Independently searched and inspected model-size, parameter and comparison contexts in the complete PDF text from the fresh October 27 primary-source fetch. The base Command A report gives a nominal 111B size and describes dense Transformer blocks, but no explicit activated-parameter comparison column or transferable active-count convention. No active count is inferred through Reasoning's named-base relationship.

sources.title: Tiny Aya: Bridging Scale and Multilingual Depth
sources.evidence: Independently inspected parameter terminology, model references and table headings in the complete later report fetched October 27. It names Command-A-Reasoning as an extractor in benchmark preparation but gives no active count for it. Table 2 distinguishes Tiny Aya embedding, non-embedding and total counts; those fields are not a definition of Reasoning active parameters.

sources.title: Hardware-aware dynamic speculative decoding
sources.evidence: Fresh search and reading of the July 10, 2026 inference study found comparisons of Command A (dense) and Command A+ (MoE), with draft-token, concurrency, throughput and latency results. It does not supply a Command A Reasoning active-parameter count or define total equals active for dense models.

sources.title: Announcing Cohere's Command A+
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 check of the May 20, 2026 launch notes confirms the 218B total and 25B active counts refer to A+, which is called Cohere's first MoE. Reasoning appears in the throughput/latency comparison without its own active count.

name.note: Official announcement name for the exact dated ID.

developer.note: Card credits Cohere and its Cohere Labs research group.

family.note: Explicitly included in the Command A family; checkpoint metadata identifies the Command A base.

release_date.note: Public launch date. Earlier repository creation is not evidence of earlier public availability.

open_weights.note: Official open-weights research release; downloads require accepting access terms.

license.note: License linked by the exact card; noncommercial weights license includes acceptable-use conditions.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 checks confirm Cohere's nominal 111B whole-model total in the exact release, model card and later A+ family comparison. Public Hub metadata corroborates the scale at 111.057580032B; retain the published nominal precision without requiring a tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-model searches, original card and later developer comparisons did not identify a separately defined active count. The A+ efficiency paragraph contrasts 218B total/25B active with Reasoning's 111B dense architecture, and its table labels Reasoning's 111B only as Size. Neither supplies an explicit active count or convention; the base Command A report, later Tiny Aya report and inference study add none. Dense classification and a named dense base alone do not justify copying the total.

architecture.note: Autoregressive dense decoder Transformer: exact metadata maps to Cohere2ForCausalLM and its dense MLP implementation. Attention alternates local windows and global layers; the four-layer pattern is not a four-layer total.

context_window.note: Explicit token count in exact-model documentation.

modalities.note: Card explicitly says text-only input and text output; later Cohere comparison agrees. Oracle image-input claim conflicts. Rendered generic capability labels are not positive support flags.

reasoning.note: Optional thinking and user-controlled thinking budget are explicitly documented.

tool_call.note: Official launch and checkpoint card document conversational tool use.

description.value: Cohere reasoning model for multilingual enterprise agents, tools, and complex workflows
description.note: Supported use-case summary, without unsupported comparative performance claims.

patch.notes: 111B is Cohere's nominal whole-model parameter count. Active parameters are not separately disclosed, including in the later Command A+ comparison. The exact checkpoint is a dense autoregressive Transformer with interleaved sliding-window and global attention. Open weights use CC-BY-NC 4.0 with an Acceptable Use Addendum. The correct checkpoint repository omits the c4ai- prefix.

sources.label: Weights license with Acceptable Use Addendum

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit confirms the published nominal 111B total. Fresh exact-model searches, reopened original card and launch, current metadata, later Command A+ comparisons, Command A and Tiny Aya technical reports, and the developer inference study yielded no separately defined active count. The A+ total/active comparison does not relabel Reasoning's dense size as active. Retained active_parameters_b as undisclosed with explicit parameter patches and preserved unrelated assessments.
